tests.name: load_float_node_with_large_integer_token
tests.intent: Probes whether image_check::full accepts a float node whose integer token exceeds 64-bit limits.

tests.name: load_float_node_with_small_integer_token
tests.intent: Probes whether image_check::full rejects a float node whose integer token fits 64 bits.

tests.name: load_float_node_exact_uint64_max_plus_one
tests.intent: Probes loading a float node for the exact boundary value 2^64 via an integer token format.

tests.name: load_float_node_negative_exceeding_int64
tests.intent: Probes image_check::full on a negative float node with a token magnitude exceeding int64_t range.

tests.name: load_float_node_negative_within_int64
tests.intent: Probes image_check::full rejection of a negative float node whose token fits int64_t.

tests.name: load_normal_float_with_fraction_unaffected
tests.intent: Probes that float tokens containing a decimal point are correctly loaded and unaffected by integer checks.

tests.name: load_normal_float_with_exponent_unaffected
tests.intent: Probes that float tokens containing an exponent character are correctly loaded.

tests.name: load_standard_integer_node_unaffected
tests.intent: Probes loading a standard integer image to verify regular integer nodes function normally under image_check::full.

tests.name: load_twenty_digit_boundary_integer_token_as_float
tests.intent: Probes 20-digit integer tokens right at the 2^64 - 1 threshold forced into float nodes.

tests.name: load_twenty_digit_boundary_exceeded_as_float
tests.intent: Probes a 20-digit integer token exceeding 18446744073709551615 forced into a float node.

tests.name: load_nineteen_digit_negative_boundary_as_float
tests.intent: Probes a 19-digit negative integer token at -9223372036854775808 forced into a float node.

tests.name: load_twenty_one_digit_token_as_float
tests.intent: Probes a 21-digit integer token forced into a float node, which should always be accepted as it exceeds 64 bits.

tests.name: load_image_check_none_bypasses_check
tests.intent: Probes that image_check::none bypasses all checks including the new integer token validation rules on float nodes.

tests.name: load_short_integer_token_as_float_node
tests.intent: Probes image_check::full rejection of a short integer token (e.g. "123") masquerading as a float node.

tests.name: load_zero_token_as_float_node
tests.intent: Probes image_check::full rejection when digit "0" token is used for a float node.

tests.name: load_positive_signed_integer_token_as_float
tests.intent: Probes image_check::full validation on a float node backed by a small explicitly signed positive integer token.

tests.name: load_large_negative_token_comparison_path
tests.intent: Probes integer_token_fits code paths explicitly for 19-digit negative tokens starting with digit other than 9.

tests.name: load_twenty_digit_token_starting_with_two
tests.intent: Probes integer_token_fits branch where 20-digit token starts with a digit greater than 1.

tests.name: load_json_view_image_check_full_default
tests.intent: Probes loading a complex JSON structure containing various numeric types with image_check::full.

tests.name: gen_20
tests.intent: Exercise integer_token_fits where t.int_digits == 20, t.negative is false, leading digit is '2', returning false without memcmp.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise integer_token_fits where t.int_digits == 19, t.negative is true, leading digit is '8', returning true without memcmp.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise integer_token_fits where t.int_digits == 19, t.negative is true, leading digit is '9', executing memcmp with "9223372036854775808".

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise integer_token_fits where t.int_digits > 20, returning false immediately.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise integer_token_fits where t.int_digits < 19 and positive, returning true directly.
